headline: Gold rises ₹152 per gram today, but remains well below last month's levels
summary: 24K gold rose ₹152 per gram today (about 1.23%) to ₹12,480, and 22K gold rose ₹140 to ₹11,440, while silver was unchanged at ₹1,65,000 per kg. Over the last 7 days gold is down about 4.5% and silver about 8.3%, and within the 32 days of recorded history gold has fallen roughly 12.6% and silver 25%. International spot prices moved only marginally since today's rate was set, so the rise looks like a catch-up after yesterday's low of ₹12,328 for 24K; likely drivers include the US dollar and rupee movements, with import duty and festive or wedding demand as possible background factors.
outlook: Today's bump is modest and prices have been volatile, so buyers who need gold can compare rates across jewellers and add GST and making charges to the quoted figure before deciding, rather than rushing.
